name: USGS National Minerals Information Center
known_limitations: USGS mineral data supports national and global materials context, but project-level conclusions require mine, processing, permitting, offtake, trade, and local infrastructure evidence.
jurisdiction: United States federal and global mineral data
automation_notes: Monitor annual mineral summaries, mineral yearbooks, commodity statistics, and critical mineral updates.
notes: Broader minerals rail complementing the existing MCS source. Phase 50B checked the Gallium Statistics and Information page and selected its production, import-supply, wafer-use, and integrated-circuit-use boundaries for a commodity-specific signal.
